speaker: narrator
text: The Tortoise and the Hare.

speaker: narrator
text: Tilly the tortoise lived in a sunny meadow.

speaker: narrator
text: She walked slowly, and she liked it that way.

speaker: narrator
text: Hugo the hare lived in the meadow too.

speaker: narrator
text: Hugo could run very, very fast.

speaker: hugo
text: I am the fastest in the whole meadow!

speaker: narrator
text: One day, Hugo saw Tilly walking by.

speaker: hugo
text: You are so slow, Tilly!

speaker: narrator
text: Tilly felt a little sad. Then she took a deep breath.

speaker: tilly
text: Let's have a race, Hugo.

speaker: narrator
text: Hugo laughed, but he said yes.

speaker: narrator
text: A little wren sat on the fence to watch.

speaker: narrator
text: Hugo and Tilly stood side by side. One, two, three, go!

speaker: narrator
text: Hugo ran off like the wind.

speaker: narrator
text: Tilly walked. Step, step, step.

speaker: narrator
text: Can you count Tilly's steps with me? One, two, three.

speaker: narrator
text: Tilly did not stop.

speaker: narrator
text: Hugo looked back. Tilly was far, far behind.

speaker: hugo
text: I have lots of time. I will take a little nap.

speaker: narrator
text: Hugo yawned, and he closed his eyes.

speaker: narrator
text: Soon he was fast asleep.

speaker: narrator
text: Tilly walked past the sleeping hare. Step, step, step.

speaker: narrator
text: The sun grew hot, and Tilly felt tired.

speaker: tilly
text: One more step. And one more.

speaker: narrator
text: She kept on going.

speaker: narrator
text: Can you see the red ribbon up ahead?

speaker: narrator
text: Step, step, step. Tilly crossed the line!

speaker: narrator
text: The little wren sang, and Tilly felt so proud.

speaker: narrator
text: Just then, Hugo woke up. He ran as fast as he could.

speaker: narrator
text: But Tilly was already there. Hugo felt surprised.

speaker: hugo
text: You won, Tilly. I am sorry I laughed.

speaker: tilly
text: Thank you, Hugo. Let's walk home together.

speaker: narrator
text: So the two friends walked home, side by side.

speaker: narrator
text: Slow and steady wins the race.

speaker: narrator
text: So keep going, step by step, just like Tilly.

speaker: narrator
text: The End.
